$comment: Information Integrity, from the GDD. Canon describes two channels of information about the world: one plentiful and unreliable, one rare and accurate, and the system only means anything if the two can DISAGREE. Canon names Jakindur as the source of the rare channel and does not supply the prose for either.
$inferred: EVERY WORD BELOW IS INVENTED, and this note is the flag. What canon supports: that there are two channels; that one is plentiful and unreliable and one is rare and accurate; that they can contradict each other; that Jakindur authored the accurate one; that the player is an intruder in a bounded arena; that the enemies are renderings of hostile code rather than creatures; and that section 10's telemetry reads the player continuously in order to grant a rune at Level 2 and a class at Level 5. What is invented: the corporate voice of the bulletins, Jakindur as a previous candidate rather than anything else, the intake-and-assessment framing, the specific contradictions, and the line in the last note that points at the ending. An earlier build shipped six unattributed fragments as a placeholder precisely so this system could replace them rather than argue with them; it now has, and those fragments remain as the opening reading because they are one channel claiming to be neither.
$design_comment: The contradiction is the mechanic, not the flavour. Every note in the rare channel names a bulletin it contradicts, the log shows the pairing the moment the player holds both halves, and the ending reads differently depending on how many of the five the player found. A player who reads only the bulletins finishes the game believing something specific and wrong, which is the entire point of an Information Integrity system and is impossible to build with one channel.
$placement_comment: Bulletins are everywhere, because plentiful is what they are - at least two per region, and the spawn has the most, since that is where an intake notice would be posted. Jakindur's are one per region and sit further out, past the ring the nodes cluster in. He was not posting them.

bulletin.name: System bulletin
bulletin.note: Plentiful and unreliable. Numbered, procedurally issued, and contradicts itself as readily as it contradicts him.

jakindur.name: Found note
jakindur.note: Rare and accurate. Handwritten, unsigned except for the initial, and never wrong about anything checkable.

notes.title: INTAKE NOTICE 0-1
notes.text: Welcome. You have been provisioned. Orientation is automatic and requires no action on your part. Questions will be answered in order of relevance.

notes.title: INTAKE NOTICE 0-4
notes.text: Your gauntlets are calibrated to you and to nobody else. Nothing else in the Coliseum can use them. This is for your protection.

notes.title: NOTICE 1-2
notes.text: Assessment has begun. Assessment is not a test. There is no pass mark, and there is nothing here that you are able to fail.

notes.title: NOTICE 1-8
notes.text: You are performing within expectations. Expectations are adjusted to what you perform.

notes.title: NOTICE 6-0
notes.text: If you are reading this, you are behind schedule. There is no schedule.

notes.title: NOTICE 2-7
notes.text: Cold is not a hazard. Cold is a region. Regions are provided so that assessment has somewhere to happen.

notes.title: NOTICE 2-9
notes.text: Candidates reaching the perimeter are reminded that the perimeter is decorative and that there is nothing on the other side of it to reach.

notes.title: NOTICE 3-1
notes.text: Exposure is a feature of the Desert. Features are not dangers. You are not in danger.

notes.title: NOTICE 3-6
notes.text: Please continue. Continuation is the only instruction, and it is the only one that has ever been issued.

notes.title: NOTICE 4-2
notes.text: Concealment is permitted. Concealment is also recorded. There is no conflict between those two sentences.

notes.title: NOTICE 4-5
notes.text: Do not be alarmed by renderings. A rendering is not a creature. It cannot want anything, and nothing that cannot want can be said to be hunting you.

notes.title: NOTICE 5-3
notes.text: This region predates your intake. Its condition is not a forecast of yours.

notes.title: NOTICE 5-8
notes.text: Completion is rewarded. The reward is release, and release is immediate upon completion.

notes.title: NOTICE 5-9
notes.text: Previous candidates have completed. Previous candidates are no longer here. Both of those facts are available to you on request.

notes.title: Scratched into a burl, low down
notes.text: It is a test. I did well on the third day and the waves changed on the fourth. Nothing adjusts to a thing it is not measuring. - J

notes.title: Folded into a split in the rock
notes.text: Walked the edge for six hours. It is not decorative. It is the only part of this place that is holding anything up, and it is made of the same stuff as the goblins. - J

notes.title: Under a cairn nobody built
notes.text: They do not want anything. Agreed. But whatever sends them does, and it sends more after you do something clever. Be less clever where it can see you. - J

notes.title: Wrapped in a bladder, above the waterline
notes.text: Concealment is permitted the way a dropped fork is permitted. They wrote a notice about it. They write notices about everything they have not worked out how to stop. - J

notes.title: On the back of a requisition slip
notes.text: I completed it. Ask where I am. The way out was never completion - the boundary is code, and your hands are for pulling code. Do not let it see you decide. - J
